translation.text: Venus is the second planet from the Sun and Earth's closest neighbor. Its thick atmosphere traps heat in an uncontrolled greenhouse effect, making it the hottest planet in the solar system.
Surface temperatures are hot enough to melt lead. Beneath its dense cloud cover lie volcanic plains and deformed mountains under atmospheric pressure 93 times that of Earth.
